maps.name: r6svg
maps.text:
<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink" width="200" height="100" viewBox="0 0 200 100">
  <g transform="rotate(20 100 50) skewX(15)">
    <rect name="A" x="20" y="20" width="40" height="30" fill="#ddeeff" stroke="#777777" stroke-width="1"/>
    <rect x="80" y="20" width="40" height="30" fill="none" stroke="#002200" stroke-width="3" stroke-dasharray="6 3" stroke-dashoffset="2"/>
    <polyline points="10,80 60,70 110,90" fill="none" stroke="#000033" stroke-width="1.5"/>
    <g name="G"><polygon points="140,20 180,30 160,60" fill="#ccffcc" stroke="#888888" stroke-width="1"/></g>
    <text x="130" y="85" font-size="12" fill="#550000" stroke="#005500" stroke-width="0.5">Hi</text>
    <image x="5" y="5" width="16" height="12" xlink:href="data:image/png;base64,iVBORw0KGgoAAAANSUhEUgAAAAEAAAABCAYAAAAfFcSJAAAADUlEQVR42mP8z8BQDwAEhQGAhKmMIQAAAABJRU5ErkJggg=="/>
  </g>
  <text x="150" y="95" font-size="10" fill="#660000" stroke="#007700" stroke-width="0.4" transform="rotate(-10 150 95)">Up</text>
</svg>

notes: every chart: chart._ssr false, env.node off, 400 x 300; the first setOption at T0.
events in order at T0 + t; a sample is zr.animation.update(), a refresh of the display list, and the record.
the roam is x / y / scaleX = scaleY = zoom only (viewCoordSysUpdateRoamTrans); MapDraw tweens it on the transform group.

cases.note: a geo component on an SVG map whose content turns and skews: a merge writes zoom 2 and a centre -- MapDraw's isFirstDraw is !regionsGroup.childAt(0) || payload, and an SVG map puts nothing in the regions group (its graphic goes in the svg group): every draw of it is a first draw, the transform group is SET to the new roam, no tween
a map series drawing its own SVG map (800 ms linear on the series): a merge writes zoom 0.5 -- the same: set at once

a geo component on a GeoJSON map (two polygons and a line string, a dashed border 2 px wide): a merge writes zoom 3 -- the transform group tweens; every region is strokeNoScale: its stroke and its dash keep their screen size through the tween

a geo component on the GeoJSON map: a merge switches it to the SVG map whose content turns and skews, with zoom 2 and a centre -- the regions group still holds the GeoJSON's regions (_buildSVG never clears it; they stay drawn, frozen: upstream's leftover), so this draw is no first draw and the transform group tweens: the SVG content rides it as it is (no turn or skew in the group, the content's own), the named shapes keep their screen width (strokeNoScale), the unnamed ones' strokes and dashes, the texts and the image grow with the group

the same switch, and 300 ms in a second merge writes zoom 0.75 and another centre on the SVG map: the regions group still holds the old regions, so the group tweens on from where it is -- the strokes follow it both ways

a geo component on the SVG map: a merge switches it to the GeoJSON map with zoom 2 -- the regions group is empty when the draw asks (it is filled after): a first draw, set at once (the SVG's graphic stays in the svg group: upstream's leftover)
a geo component on the GeoJSON map: a merge hides it (GeoView.render removes its MapDraw), and a merge shows it again on the SVG map with zoom 2 -- a new MapDraw, its regions group empty: set at once

a map series on the GeoJSON map: the legend hides it (MapView.remove clears its MapDraw), a merge switches it to the SVG map while hidden, the legend shows it (a new MapDraw on the SVG: its regions group empty), and a merge writes zoom 2 -- a first draw, set at once

guards.name: the transform group never turns, skews or takes an origin
an SVG map is set at once (no tween)
a GeoJSON map tweens, and so does the switch to SVG
the views made anew are set at once
the switch leaves the old regions drawn
the SVG content turns and skews (its own transform)
every element rides the group: gm now = (group now / group at the end) * gm at the end
a named shape keeps its screen width; an unnamed one grows
the polygon named from its group is strokeNoScale
a GeoJSON region keeps its screen width and dash
the texts scale with the group
midway: the second tween starts where the first was
